scope: Vulkan XR screen presenter with injected XR calls and real Vulkan images; no live XR runtime/compositor or gameplay
checks: Timeout hides layer and preserves acquired ownership
New publication cannot replace frame held for retry
Retry copies original frame with no reacquire
Readback of actual injected destination image matches every selected RGBA byte
No new frame reuses released image without acquire
Resize16x16to8x8 updates target and quad extent
Opaque quad composed via frame begin/flat end-frame
